name: Hardware Corner lab: RTX 5080 Qwen3-8B Q4_K_XL decode @ 16k ctx
methodology: THIRD-PARTY LAB MEASURED (Hardware Corner, 'Definitive GPU Ranking for LLMs', updated Dec 9 2025). llama.cpp llama-bench on Ubuntu 24.04, CUDA 12.8, Q4_K_XL quantization, single GPU. Decode tok/s for Qwen3 8B at 16k context length. Per-request batch-1 generation, not aggregate.
notes: In-lab measured decode at 16k context. Part of a controlled cross-GPU sweep (same engine build + quant + harness on every card). Context-length scaling: decode falls as KV cache grows — 16K is the least-memory-pressured point. format_id gguf-q4-k-m used as nearest standard 4-bit GGUF record; the source specifies 'Q4_K_XL' (Unsloth XL dynamic quant) which has no dedicated quantization record.
